title: The inventory — 128 registered tools classified, and the fake `hou` that explains 90 of them
status_note: Amber, not green. The oracle is satisfied on its face — all 128 registered tools carry a class, the counts are integers with a producer path, the artist-task grouping exists and names its thin groups. But two oracle-adjacent conditions failed and the leg refuses to call that green: (1) the adversarial refutation pass NEVER RAN — 8 of 10 fan-out agents died on a session token limit, so 31 carried verdicts are UNREFUTED; (2) 5 tools are UNKNOWN because nothing reached them. Law 7: a red/amber leg is a finding, not a failure. Softening this to green would destroy the only instrument that worked.
settings_profile: harness/readonly-settings.json (READ-ONLY leg; writes confined to harness/notes/**)
mode: read-only inventory; zero tracked files modified
houdini_build_live: 22.0.368 (bridge ws://localhost:9999, pid 38084, symbol-table stamp == running build)

the_headline.what_the_controls_changed: Three verdicts moved because controls were run, and one framing was withdrawn. (1) synapse_recall: provisionally UNREACHABLE on a 1800s hang; isolation control returned FAST, hang was concurrency-induced, verdict WITHDRAWN to PARTIAL. (2) synapse_scout: its control produced a MECHANISM instead of a hang — a SQLite cross-thread ProgrammingError (S1-F4). (3) synapse_metrics: PARTIAL -> WORKS once actually called. (4) The 'trivial 9-node scene' framing on S1-F2 is WITHDRAWN — two metrics surfaces in the same session report 9 and 16122 nodes (S1-F13). The verdicts that did NOT move survived the identical test, which is the only reason they are worth trusting.
the_headline.producer: harness/notes/forensic/_s1_classify.py -> s1_classification.json. No count hand-entered; the script exits non-zero if the verdict set and the census disagree.
the_headline.the_sentence: SYNAPSE registers 128 tools, and the 24 that are proven are mostly the ones it uses to talk to itself. Every tool that would put an image on screen — 13 rendering, 4 lighting, 2 comp — is unproven on a host, not because the code is bad but because 5 of 286 test files are capable of disagreeing with Houdini.
the_headline.second_axis: 12 of the 24 WORKS tools are agent-internal, and exactly 1 of those 25 agent-internal tools is something an artist would reach for. WORKS count in rendering / lighting / caching / comp is ZERO in all four.

findings.summary: A canonical FAKE `hou` is planted into sys.modules at collection time, so `import hou` always succeeds under plain pytest and `pytest.importorskip("hou")` gates nothing anywhere in this suite. Only a host-IDENTITY probe (`__synapse_canonical__`) is a real gate.
findings.evidence: 5 of 286 test files carry that gate and assert host behaviour: tests/solaris/test_live_wiring.py, test_h22_cops_solver_live.py, test_h22_setdressing_live.py, test_guards.py, test_introspection.py. 101 files build a mock. 2 use importorskip('hou') and are therefore ungated.
findings.producer: harness/notes/forensic/_s1_test_honesty.py -> s1_test_honesty.json; the script voids its own numbers if the planting block leaves conftest.py.
findings.why_it_bites: This is the single reason 90 of 128 tools are PARTIAL. A green 4,873-test suite is real evidence about payload contracts and regressions, and NO evidence that a tool moves Houdini. The brief's warning about mock tests describes the suite's default condition, not an edge case.

findings.summary: synapse_inspect_scene does not return. Called live twice; ran 1800s and was aborted by the MCP idle timeout.
findings.evidence: Control run: re-invoked ALONE, nothing else in flight, max_depth=1, against a 9-node EMPTY scene (untitled.hip). It ran the FULL 1800s and was aborted with no response — identical to the first call — while synapse_ping answered instantly in the same session and the bridge stayed healthy throughout. The concurrency explanation is REFUTED, and the isolated run did not merely block past a 120s foreground budget: it never returned. Two-sided control, both sides observed to termination.
findings.why_it_bites: synapse_group_scene — the knowledge preamble served to the LLM — explicitly instructs 'Always inspect before mutating -- use synapse_inspect_node or synapse_inspect_scene first.' The documented entry point to every scene workflow does not return.
findings.not_established: The mechanism. Candidate carried, untested: _node_issues calls node.errors() (introspection.py:184), which forces cooks. Root-causing is S2's job; S1 records the observation.

findings.summary: synapse_router_stats is structurally incapable of returning data through the MCP surface. Called live: {"error":"Router not initialized"}.
findings.evidence: self._router is constructed in exactly ONE place, _handle_route_chat, and route_chat is one of 7 handlers no MCP tool dispatches to (s1_reachability.json dead_handlers_no_tool_reaches). Only the Houdini panel sends route_chat (panel/chat_panel.py:799,903). Static proof and live observation agree.
findings.collateral: synapse_metrics guards on hasattr(self,'_router') at handlers.py:1500 and therefore always emits router_stats=None on this path — silently, with no note to the caller.

findings.summary: synapse_scout fails on SQLite THREAD AFFINITY. Not a hang — slow, then a hard error. Mechanism found, not inferred.
findings.evidence: Called live twice. First: 1800s, no response, aborted. Second, ALONE, single trivial symbol query (k=2): blocked past 120s and then RETURNED {"error":"ProgrammingError","message":"SQLite objects created in a thread can only be used in that same thread. The object was created in thread id 51668 and this is thread id 65704."} The retrieval store's connection is created on one thread and used on another. The concurrency explanation is refuted (synapse_recall, tested identically in the same session, returned fast).
findings.how_it_was_found: The control was run ONLY to rule out concurrency, per the two-sided-control discipline. It produced the mechanism instead. This is the one hang in this leg that is NOT handed to S2 as a mystery.
findings.why_it_bites: CLAUDE.md rule 15 makes scout the MANDATORY pre-flight before emitting any unfamiliar hou./pdg./pxr. call — the project's front-line defence against its self-declared #1 failure class (phantom APIs). It did not answer.
findings.not_same_class: synapse_recall LOOKED like the same defect and is not. Its control returned fast; verdict withdrawn to PARTIAL. Two tools hung in the same concurrent burst and only one of them has a defect — which is exactly what the control was for.

findings.summary: The registered tool surface is 128, not the 120 the CLAUDE.md banner states. 120 is the size of TOOL_DEFS; 6 group-info tools + synapse_inspect_stage + synapse_scout are appended by list_tools().
findings.evidence: Static census (_s1_enumerate_tools.py) and this session's own live MCP listing agree exactly: 128 mcp__synapse__* tools — 21 cops_*, 40 houdini_*, 50 synapse_*, 17 tops_*.
findings.note: Not a contradiction of the seed fact — the seed is right about TOOL_DEFS and right about the banner. It is drift: the quoted number is 8 short of the served number, and the classification surface is 128.

findings.summary: The Solaris family is the ONE family with honest host evidence, and the mechanism that produced it is worth naming: the mock fixtures were DELETED under Constitution Law 1, not supplemented.
findings.evidence: What replaced them gates on host IDENTITY (the planted fake carries __synapse_canonical__; real Houdini does not), skips honestly off-host, and executes under hython 22.0.368. That tier then FOUND F7 (set_purpose reporting success having set nothing) and F9 (import_megascans raising PermissionError on every invocation). Both repaired. SR1 receipt green, suite 4841->4873 passed / 0 failed / +9 skipped — those skips ARE the live tier standing down off-host.
findings.why_it_matters: This is the repo's own proof that live gating works. The mock said green while the tool set nothing; deleting the mock is what found it. It is also the counter-example to S1-F1 — the fix is known, demonstrated, and confined to one family.

findings.summary: The artist-facing groups are the empty ones. WORKS count is ZERO in rendering (13 PARTIAL), lighting (4), caching (8) and comp (2).
findings.evidence: Of 24 WORKS: 12 agent-internal, 7 scene-assembly, 3 look-dev, 1 debugging, 1 pipeline-admin. Exactly 1 of the 25 agent-internal tools is one an artist would reach for.
findings.the_inversion: Half of everything proven is a tool the agent uses to orient itself. SYNAPSE can reliably report the frame, its memory, its health and its recipes. Nothing that puts an image on screen or a light in a scene has been observed working.

findings.summary: The highest-leverage tool in the inventory has no host evidence. synapse_solaris_assemble_chain auto-wires unwired LOP nodes into canonical order — the clearest 'twenty minutes off every shot setup' claim in the product — and its 3 tests are mock/registration only. It is not in the live tier that covers its four siblings.
findings.evidence: Its siblings (component_builder, scene_template, set_purpose, import_megascans) are covered by tests/solaris/test_live_wiring.py. assemble_chain is not. The family reads uniformly green from outside; it is not uniform.
findings.adjacent: synapse_solaris_create_variants is in the live file but its ONLY live test is a NEGATIVE one (test_create_variants_rejects_a_non_lop_path_live:313). Nothing live asserts it builds a variant.

findings.summary: houdini_undo and houdini_redo do not marshal to Houdini's main thread — neither calls run_on_main, unlike essentially every sibling handler.
findings.evidence: handlers.py:882 calls hou.undos.performUndo() directly on the handler thread. The redo case was found independently by the batch-3 reader. The WS transport calls handle() from a server thread.
findings.why_it_bites: Undo grouping is the product's headline safety claim — 'every action reversible and recorded'. Its two entry points are both unproven on the host AND unmarshalled.

findings.summary: Ten registered tools have zero tests naming them anywhere in 286 test files.
findings.evidence: houdini_configure_light_linking, houdini_create_point_instancer, houdini_manage_collection, houdini_manage_variant_set, houdini_reference_usd, houdini_set_payload_loadstate, houdini_shot_render_ready, synapse_configure_render_passes, synapse_live_metrics, synapse_memory_write.
findings.sharpest: synapse_configure_render_passes — a genuinely useful 17-entry AOV preset table, emitted as GENERATED PYTHON that calls editableStage() (returns None outside a LOP cook), with no test anywhere.
findings.counterpoint_worth_keeping: houdini_create_node is the MOST-tested tool in the product (32 tests) and still has no host-behaviour evidence. Test count and evidence are independent axes here.

findings.summary: Two SCAFFOLDs beyond the three the brief named: cops_growth_propagation and cops_procedural_texture. Also 7 dead handlers that no registered tool reaches.
findings.evidence: Dead handlers: assess_render_ready, get_help, matlib_bind, route_chat, solaris_shotsetup_karma_xpu, tops_pause_cook, tops_resume_cook. This inverse list is the POSITIVE CONTROL for the reachability diff — it proves the check runs in both directions rather than passing vacuously (Law 1).
findings.note: A 4th self-report marker fired on cops_create_copnet, but reading it clears the tool: its name promises only the network, which it delivers. Self-report is a lead, not a verdict.

findings.summary: Three memory tools give three different answers about whether memory exists, in the same live session.
findings.evidence: synapse_memory_status returned entries_total 19. synapse_context returned 23 memories with real authored scene notes. synapse_recall returned {"error":"Memory not available","found":false} — while its RAG half worked correctly (knowledge_found true, confidence 0.8125, correct punycode parm names).
findings.why_it_bites: The recall path is the one an agent uses mid-session to answer 'have we decided this before'. It is the only one of the three that reports memory absent, and it reports it inside a success-shaped payload rather than raising.
findings.found_by: The isolation control run for S1-F4 — the test that WITHDREW this tool's UNREACHABLE verdict is the same test that found the real defect underneath it.
findings.note: Contract 1 already names the single-source-of-truth problem in this area: handlers_memory.py:230-242 patches memory_status's count from the live store because it 'contradicted synapse_context'. Recall was not included in that reconciliation.

findings.summary: Two metrics surfaces report the scene's node count three orders of magnitude apart, in the same session, minutes apart.
findings.evidence: synapse_live_metrics returned total_nodes 9 with obj_nodes 0, sop_nodes 0, lop_nodes 0. synapse_metrics returned synapse_scene_nodes_total 16122 with synapse_scene_warnings 3. Both are read-only, both were called live this session, neither raised.
findings.why_it_bites: It also forced a CORRECTION to this leg's own S1-F2 write-up, which had characterised the live scene as a 'trivial 9-node empty scene' on the strength of the first number. That framing is withdrawn. If 16122 is the true walk size, the node.errors() candidate for the inspect_scene hang becomes MORE plausible, not less — so the contradiction is not cosmetic, it changes which mechanism is likely.
findings.self_correction: Recorded rather than quietly fixed. An earlier draft of S1_INVENTORY.md asserted the 9-node framing; the assertion is withdrawn in place, with the reason, per Article VI.

findings.summary: SYNAPSE's own telemetry already names its slowest tool, and it is the one that does not return.
findings.evidence: synapse_metrics returns synapse_panel_inline_slow_total{slowest_tool="synapse_inspect_scene"}, plus a real run_on_main dispatch-wait histogram (299 samples, max 698ms) and a main-thread direct-path histogram. This is genuine instrumentation, not a stub — and it corroborates S1-F2 from a completely independent direction, unprompted.
findings.note: The observability layer works. Nothing reads it.

method.live_probes: Read-only tools only, called through the /mcp bridge against the artist's live Houdini 22.0.368. No mutating tool was exercised. Probed: ping, health, doctor, scene_info, memory_status, list_recipes, context, knowledge_lookup, group_scene, hda_list, live_metrics, router_stats, stage_info, inspect_scene (x2, incl. isolation control), recall, scout.
method.two_sided_control: s1_reachability.py reports BOTH unreachable-tools and dead-handlers; the 7 dead handlers are the positive control proving the diff can fire. The inspect_scene hang got an isolation re-run that refutes the concurrency explanation; recall and scout did NOT and are flagged weaker.

counts_by_provenance.note: Provenance is recorded per verdict in s1_classification.json so a reader can discount each source differently. Agent verdicts were carried verbatim and NOT upgraded.

suite.why: Read-only leg. Constitution Article V: a leg under the read-only profile has no pytest grant and must not claim suite evidence.
suite.structural_verification: git status --porcelain snapshotted before fan-out and re-read after: identical except harness/notes/forensic/ (this leg's own writable path) and the orchestrator's .orch_launched marker. `git diff HEAD --stat` is EMPTY — zero tracked files modified.
suite.borrowed_number_disclosure: The 4841->4873 suite figures quoted for the Solaris family are READ FROM harness/notes/receipts/SR1.json, not measured here. Cited as SR1's number, never as S1's.

fan_out_containment.failure_cause: session token limit (resets 1:20pm America/New_York) — not an agent defect
fan_out_containment.write_fence: Both agent types hold Read/Grep/Glob/Bash only — no Write/Edit in the definition, which is the structural fence rather than a prompt instruction.
fan_out_containment.method: git status --porcelain before and after; identical.

not_established: The adversarial refutation pass. It never ran. 31 verdicts are carried UNREFUTED and tagged as such.
5 tools are UNKNOWN: cops_stamp_scatter, cops_stylize, cops_temporal_analysis, cops_to_materialx, cops_wetmap.
82 of 128 tools mutate and were deliberately not exercised — this leg is read-only against a live artist session.
The live scene was untitled.hip: 9 nodes, no USD stage, no TOP network. houdini_stage_info could only prove its refusal path; all 17 TOPS tools had nothing to run against.
The mechanism behind the two surviving hangs. Observation only; root-causing belongs to S2.
Why synapse_recall reports memory absent while memory_status and context both report it present (S1-F12). Observed, not explained.

for_ruling.question: Should the CLAUDE.md banner read 128, or should the 8 non-TOOL_DEFS tools be folded into TOOL_DEFS so one number is true?
for_ruling.context: S1-F5. The banner says 120 (= TOOL_DEFS); the wire serves 128. Both numbers are defensible descriptions of different things, which is exactly why one of them keeps getting quoted as the other.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I — which number a governing document should carry is a value judgement, not a fact from the tree.

for_ruling.question: Does the Solaris live-gating pattern (delete the mock, gate on host identity, skip honestly off-host) become the standard for the tools an artist actually reaches for — and if so, in what order?
for_ruling.context: S1-F1 + S1-F6 + S1-F7. The pattern is proven in-repo and it FOUND two real defects that mocks had hidden. Applying it to all 128 is a large cost; applying it to zero leaves 90 PARTIAL. The inventory suggests an order — assemble_chain (S1-F8), then create_node, then the undo pair (S1-F9), then rendering — but which of those is worth the cost is product direction.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I — what to build and in what order is a value judgement between defensible options.

for_ruling.question: Is synapse_inspect_scene a release blocker?
for_ruling.context: S1-F2. It does not return on a 9-node empty scene, controlled. It is also the tool the shipped group-knowledge preamble instructs the agent to call FIRST before any mutation. So the documented first step of every scene workflow does not terminate — but no artist has ever run this product, so nothing is currently broken FOR anyone.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Whether an unshipped product has a blocker is a judgement about release posture, not a fact provable from the tree.

for_ruling.question: Re-run the killed S1 fan-out after the session limit resets, or accept 31 UNREFUTED verdicts and 5 UNKNOWN?
for_ruling.context: The workflow is resumable: Workflow({scriptPath: '<session>/workflows/scripts/s1-tool-inventory-wf_cb86d227-4cd.js', resumeFromRunId: 'wf_cb86d227-4cd'}) replays the 2 completed agents from cache and runs only the 8 that died. Cost is ~8 agents; benefit is the adversarial pass this leg's own oracle asked for.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Spending another fan-out is a budget decision.

for_ruling.question: The 62 recipes are the most substantial artist-facing asset found in this leg and are reachable only via synapse_list_recipes. Is that the intended surface?
for_ruling.context: Live-verified: real cinema-camera sensor data for 8 bodies, lighting-law-compliant rigs, destruction and vellum chains, turntables with AOVs. They are domain knowledge, not tools, and nothing in the tool surface advertises them to an artist.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Product surfacing decision, not a fact from the tree.
